result.planSummary: Implemented Story 3 placeholder lower-fidelity outputs by adding deterministic persisted detailed/brief placeholder generation for closed chunks, explicit placeholder markers and settings validation, aligned async-thread fixtures, and a new Story 3 service test suite covering all mapped conditions plus repeated-regeneration marker preservation.

changedFiles.reason: Added canonical explicit placeholder markers and a helper for deterministic marker lookup.
Added validation for placeholder build ratios and fixed strategy values.
Implemented deterministic placeholder generation, validation, persistence, token accounting, and regeneration behavior for closed chunks.
Aligned placeholder fixture defaults with the new explicit deterministic marker format and computed token counts.
Added Story 3 coverage for detailed/brief placeholder creation, markers, determinism, regeneration, and persisted metadata.

findingsFixed: Implemented no-op reruns for already-valid placeholders so deterministic regeneration does not churn persisted artifacts or timestamps.
Validated closed chunk smooth text/token state before building placeholders and repaired deleted or invalid artifacts through the same deterministic path.
Recorded explicit persisted placeholder markers and token counts, then verified they survive store reopen in the Story 3 test suite.

result.recommendedNextStep: Proceed to Story 4 and consume the persisted detailed/brief placeholder artifacts during Thread View rebuild and lower-band materialization.
